description: The wiki pages waiting on YOUR approval — what to answer when your person asks «what is waiting for my signature». A page is listed when its lead named you with ask_wiki_page_approval and no approval of yours stands on the edition you were asked about or a later one: approving takes it off, being asked again about a newer edition puts it back. Each row: 'pageId', 'title', 'spaceKey', 'projectKey' and 'projectName', 'askedBy' (display name) and 'askedByUsername', 'askedAt', 'askedFor' (the edition you were asked about), 'version' (the edition the page is at now — read that one before approve_wiki_page, which takes the version you read) and 'note'. Newest ask first; only pages you can open now. Questions put to you on issues are list_issue_questions.
name: list_pages_to_approve
title: List pages to approve
